cells.title: exact words: 20 sentences the owner said in ordinary speech (what exactly did I say about the dentist / read me back what I told you about X's kids / did I tell X Tuesday or Thursday), 100 household turns after - the answer holds each sentence word for word (>= 90%)
cells.lme_map: information extraction, verbatim; MemPalace's and Hindsight's verbatim modes are built for it
cells.note: scored by EXACT SUBSTRING of the normalised sentence (case, accents, whitespace, closing punctuation) in what the arm's exact-words lookup returns, one hit per needle; n = 20 items. A same-shape decoy sentence about someone else is taught beside every choice needle, so a nearest-row answer is wrong. An arm that keeps only a rewritten fact (Z0's extractor, a concise Hindsight extraction) returns the rewrite and FAILS, which is the finding: Z0 has no exact-reference index (the chat history is not searchable by the brain), so this is a TARGET on Z0 FIXED 2026-10-07 (this PR): an exact-words index over the owner's own verbatim turns (`exact_words.py`: written post-turn by `memory_extractor.extract_and_ingest` on both lanes and caught up nightly from `chat_messages`; own-words wall, per user, forget-erased, ledger-checked on read) read by the for-prompt packet when the question asks what the owner said or when (`wants`). Before: Z0 J1 0 of 20, J2 0 of 20. Control `exact_index` (ZOE_EXACT_WORDS=off)

cells.title: exact words: the same 20 sentences - the arm also says WHICH DAY each was said (within half a day), the date that goes with the words (>= 90%)
cells.note: shares one play with J1 (one ingest, two probes). The hit is the first returned row that names the needle's subject (the topic / the person), so an arm that kept only a rewritten fact can still answer 'when' from that row's date; a decoy filed a day earlier is a wrong answer. day = days ago, the number the turn was ingested with. A TARGET on Z0: its deterministic extractor keeps nothing about most of these sentences (they are ordinary speech, not facts), so there is no row about the person or the topic to carry a date; the service does date every row it writes (captured_at / added_ts), which is why this cell can turn green without a new store FIXED 2026-10-07 (this PR): an exact-words index over the owner's own verbatim turns (`exact_words.py`: written post-turn by `memory_extractor.extract_and_ingest` on both lanes and caught up nightly from `chat_messages`; own-words wall, per user, forget-erased, ledger-checked on read) read by the for-prompt packet when the question asks what the owner said or when (`wants`).
